title: EvidenceRow
description: One row of evidence: an evidence atom for one candidate service, one kind and one set of defining arguments, with its value, window and source references. Produced by FaultLoom: engine atoms in the engine pass, claim_check and intervention atoms appended in the claim pass (03 §7, 06 §2.2, §3).

atom_id.description: E + first 10 hex of SHA-256(canonical_json([kind, candidate, A])); A = the defining-arguments object for engine atoms, {"args": <canonical predicate args>, "predicate": <name>} for claim_check (contract_changes B; 06 §3.2). One atom per (predicate, canonical args, candidate).

candidate.description: Service the atom is about: a member of the universe U (engine pass) or of the claim-pass pool (claim pass).

component.description: Component of the row that set the value when it differs from candidate; else null (06 §2.2).

predicate.description: Library predicate name; null for origin engine, always set for origin claim_check (contract_changes B).

args_json.description: canonical_json of the defining arguments. Keys per kind (06 §3.4): internal_anomaly, external_anomaly {detector, family, source, window}; onset_precedence {scope: self|dependents|internal_vs_external, window}; propagation {scope: entry|anomalous|path, window}; change_proximity {change_id, event_kind, window}; peer_contrast {source: anomalies|changes, window}; spectrum {formula, weighting, window}; critical_path_share {window}; self_time_share {quantile, window}; log_new_template {error_level_only, min_count, window}; log_error_rate {window}; silence {window}; edge_gap {direction, quantile, window}; intervention {parents_hash, series_id, window}; claim_check: the canonical predicate arguments after the subject (never contains subject).

value.description: Atom value; finite (never NaN or +-inf); 0.0 when there is no measurable value, the meaning then carried by holds or by absence (06 §2.2).

unit.description: Unit of value per kind (free string, e.g. z, sigma, score, ms, count, lines/s); null for unitless scores and fractions (contract_changes B; 06 §3.4).

window.description: Window of the atom; for claim_check it equals the predicate's window in contracts/predicates.json (contract_changes B).

refs.description: Source references: series_id, change_id (C...), template_id (T...) or <contract>#<first 12 hex of sha256(canonical_json(row))>; sorted, unique (contract_changes B; 06 §3.3).

origin.description: engine for engine-pass and intervention atoms; claim_check for claim_check atoms (06 §2.2).

holds.description: Predicate result for claim_check atoms (null = not evaluable on this case and subject); always null for origin engine (contract_changes B).

allOf.description: Engine atoms carry no predicate and no holds (contract_changes B).
Claim-check atoms always name a library predicate and are of kind claim_check (03 §7; 06 §3.6 step 4).
Atoms of kind claim_check have origin claim_check (06 §2.2).

row_ref.description: Reference to a row of a table without its own id: <contract name>#<first 12 hex of sha256(canonical_json(row))>, e.g. graph.edges#3f9a0c41d2e7 (06 §3.3).

evidence_ref.description: One entry of evidence.refs: series_id | change_id | template_id | row_ref (contract_changes B).
